book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: مية هندي، على خيل، حوالي القطار.
sentences.en: A hundred Indians, on horseback, around the train.
Firing, yelling, climbing the cars.
And the passengers firing from the windows.
And Aouda with a pistol, firing, her hand steady.
And Passepartout with his six guns.
And the Indians reached the engine.
And struck the driver, and threw him off.
And the train ran on with no one driving.
And ahead, two miles off, Fort Kearney station.
And in it soldiers.

sentences.ar: بس القطار ما بيوقف، والهنود بيعرفوا.
sentences.en: But the train would not stop, and the Indians knew it.

sentences.ar: إذا مرق المحطة، ما حدا بيساعد.
sentences.en: If it passed the station, no one would help.

sentences.ar: قال الكمساري: لازم حدا يوصل للقاطرة، ويفصلها.
sentences.en: The conductor said: someone must reach the engine, and uncouple it.
From under the cars.
And no one moved.
And Passepartout said: me.

sentences.ar: وقبل ما حدا يحكي، نزل من الباب، وتعلق تحت العربة.
sentences.en: And before anyone could speak, he went out the door, and hung beneath the car.
The track beneath him, the wheels beside him.

sentences.ar: وزحف، عربة ورا عربة، على السلاسل.
sentences.en: And crawled, car after car, along the chains.
An acrobat.
And reached the engine, and undid the coupling.
And the engine shot ahead.
And the cars slowed, and slowed, and stopped.
Right in front of the station.
And the soldiers came out, and the Indians fled.
And took with them three passengers.
Prisoners.
And Passepartout was one of them.
And Fogg stood on the platform.
And Aouda weeping.
And Fogg said: I will bring him back.
Alive or dead.
And Fix said: and the wager?
Fogg said: my duty.

sentences.ar: وأخد تلاتين جندي، وراح ورا الهنود، بالتلج.
sentences.en: And took thirty soldiers, and went after the Indians, into the snow.
